params.name: ComponentsToCopy

params.desc: Array of boolean values; each value indicates whether to use the existing mate reference for the corresponding component to copy; if true, copies the existing mate reference; if false, uses the corresponding entry in the NewEntityToMateTo array for the new mate reference

params.name: NewEnityToMateTo
params.desc: Array of new mate references that map to the Repeat array; if an entry in the Repeat array is false, then the corresponding entry in this array is the new entity with which to mate the component to copy

params.desc: Array of distance or angle values for the mate references; specify distance in meters and angle in radians; valid for distance, angle, and profile center mates only

params.name: FlipAlignment

params.desc: Array of booleans that map to the Values array; each value indicates the corresponding mate's distance; true for a positive distance dimension, false for a negative distance dimension; valid for distance, angle, and profile center mates only

params.name: LockRotation
params.desc: Array of booleans that map to the NewEntityToMateTo array; true to prevent the components from rotating, false to allow the components to rotate; valid for concentric and profile center mates only

params.name: Orientation
params.desc: Array of longs or integers that map to the Values array; each long or integer indicates the number of clicks in the user interface with which to orient the mate; a positive value indicates to orient the mate clockwise, a negative value indicates to orient the mate counterclockwise; valid for profile center mates only

params.name: LowerTextContent
params.desc:
Lower-text content style as defined by swBalloonTextContent_e or specify -1 to use the document default lower text content 
 NOTE: This and the next argument are only effective when Style is set to swBS_SplitCirc. See the SOLIDWORKS Help for additional details about autoballoons.

params.name: LowerText
params.desc: Text for lower balloon

params.name: Layername
params.desc: Name of the layer for this balloon

params.name: BalloonsToFaces

params.desc: Array of doubles; coordinates of this entity that were used to measure the distance

IFeatureManager.AddCornerReliefType.decl:
Function AddCornerReliefType( _
 ByVal CornerIndex As System.Integer, _
 ByVal ReliefType As System.Integer, _
 ByVal Length1 As System.Double, _
 ByVal Length2 As System.Double, _
 ByVal Length3 As System.Double, _
 ByVal CenterOnBendLines As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal RatioToThickness As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal TangentToBend As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal AddFilletedCorners As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal NarrowCorner As System.Boolean _
) As System.Boolean

params.name: CornerIndex
params.desc: Index of corner to which to apply the corner relief; -1 to apply it to the corner last added with IFeatureManager::AddCornerReliefCorner

params.name: ReliefType
params.desc: Type of corner relief as defined by swCornerReliefType_e

params.name: Length1
params.desc: Not used

params.name: Length2
params.desc:
If ReliefType is swCornerReliefType_e... 
 Then Length2 is the slot... 
 
 
 
 swCornerSquareRelief 
 Length of the corner relief 
 
 
 swCornerObroundRelief 
 Length of the corner relief 
 
 swCornerCircularRelief 
 Radius of the corner relief

params.name: Length3
params.desc:
If ReliefType is swCornerReliefType_e... 
 Then Length3 is... 
 
 
 swCornerObroundRelief 
 Slot width of the corner relief 
 
 swCornerSquareRelief and FilletedCorners = true 
 Radius of filleted corner

params.name: CenterOnBendLines
params.desc:
True to center the corner relief relative to the bend lines, false to not; valid only if ReliefType is one of the following: 
 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerSquareRelief 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerCircularRelief 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerObroundRelief

params.name: RatioToThickness
params.desc:
True to use a ratio value to cut the bend area so that the body can be folded, false to not; the ratios for valid relief types are calculated as follows where t = thickness of sheet metal: 
 
 
 
 
 If ReliefType is swCornerReliefType_e... 
 Then ratios are... 
 
 
 
 swCornerSquareRelief 
 Length2/t 
 
 
 swCornerCircularRelief 
 Length2/t 
 
 
 swCornerObroundRelief 
 
 Length2/t and Length3/t

params.name: TangentToBend
params.desc: True to make the corner relief tangent to the inside bend edges, false to not

params.name: AddFilletedCorners
params.desc: True to fillet the corner relief corners, false to not; valid only if ReliefType = swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerSquareRelief

params.name: NarrowCorner
params.desc:
True to use the algorithm for large bend radii to narrow the corner relief in the bend area, false to not; valid only if ReliefType is one of the following: 
 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerSquareRelief 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerCircularRelief 
 swCornerReliefType_e.swCornerObroundRelief

IFeatureManager.DraftXpertChange.decl:
Function DraftXpertChange( _
 ByVal Angle As System.Double, _
 ByVal FlipDir As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal EdgeDraft As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal PropType As System.Integer, _
 ByVal IsStepDraft As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsBodyDraft As System.Boolean _
) As Feature

params.name: Angle
params.desc: Draft angle in radians

params.name: FlipDir
params.desc: True to flip the direction of the draft (the draft direction is determined by the selected direction, which could be a planar face, a reference plane, an edge, or two vertices; if you refer to the last argument in IModelDocExtension::SelectByID2 , then these items have a selection mark of 1; the faces to draft have a selection mark of 2, and the draft edges have a selection mark of 4), false to not

params.name: EdgeDraft
params.desc: True if this is an edge draft and the user selects edges to draft, false if this is a face draft and the user selects faces to draft (SOLIDWORKS automatically selects the faces next to the edge to be drafted)

params.name: PropType
params.desc:
Propagation type: 
 
 
 0 = no propagation 
 
 1 = propagate to the next tangent faces that share the base neutral plane; valid for edge draft or neutral plane draft 
 
 2 = propagate to all faces that are a neighbor of the neutral plane 
 
 3 = propagate to all faces that a neighbor of the neutral plane on all inner loops (for example, all faces of a pocket or a boss) 
 
 4 = propagate to all faces that are a neighbor of the neutral plane on the outer loop (for example, the sides of a box with the bottom face as the neutral plane)

params.name: IsStepDraft
params.desc: True if the draft is a step draft, false if not

params.name: IsBodyDraft
params.desc: True if the draft is a body draft, false if not

params.desc: True to specify the gusset section plane offset on the opposite side of the selected reference point, false to not; valid only if BOffset is true

params.desc:

 0 = indent 
 1 = profile dimensioning 
 (see Remarks )

params.desc: d1 gusset leg length; length of sheet metal from bend to intersection with first end of gusset; valid only if ProfDimType = 1 (see Remarks )

params.desc: True to dimension the angle that is formed by the intersection of the gusset with either face adjacent to the bend; valid only if ProfDimType = 1 (see Remarks )

params.desc: d2 gusset leg length; length of sheet metal from bend to intersection with second end of gusset; valid only if ProfDimType = 1 (see Remarks )

params.desc: True to swap d1 and d2 in the dimensioning scheme, false to not; valid only if ProfDimType = 1 (see Remarks )

params.name: DWidth
params.desc: Gusset width

params.name: DThickness
params.desc: Gusset thickness

params.name: BDraft
params.desc: True to draft gusset side faces, false to not

params.name: DDraftAngle
params.desc: Angle by which to draft the gusset side faces; valid only if BDraft is true

params.name: BInnerCornerFillet
params.desc: True to fillet the gusset inner corners, false to not

params.name: DInnerCornerFilletRadius
params.desc: Inner corner fillet radius; valid only if BInnerCornerFillet is true

params.name: BOuterCornerFillet
params.desc: True to fillet the gusset outer corners, false to not

params.name: DOuterCornerFilletRadius
params.desc: Outer corner fillet radius; valid only if BOuterCornerFilletRadius is true

params.name: GussetType
params.desc:
Type of gusset: 
 
 0 = rounded back 
 1 = flat back

params.name: BEdgeFillet
params.desc: True to fillet the edges of a gusset, false to not; valid only if GussetType = 1

params.name: DEdgeFilletRadius
params.desc: Edge fillet radius; valid only if BEdgeFillet is true and GussetType = 1

params.desc: Function to call when this item is selected (see Remarks )

params.name: UpdateCallbackFunction
params.desc:
Optional function that controls the state of the item; if specified, then SOLIDWORKS calls this function before displaying the item 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If UpdateCallbackFunction returns... 
 
 Then SOLIDWORKS... 
 
 
 0 
 
 Deselects and disables the item 
 
 
 1 
 
 Deselects and enables the item; this is the default state if no update function is specified 
 
 
 2 
 
 Selects and disables the item 
 
 
 3 
 
 Selects and enables the item 
 
 
 4 
 Hides the item (see Remarks )

IModeler.CreateLoftBody.title: CreateLoftBody Method (IModeler)
IModeler.CreateLoftBody.decl:
Function CreateLoftBody( _
 ByVal PModDoc As ModelDoc2, _
 ByVal IsBlendClosed As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal KeepTangency As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal ForceNonRational As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsSolidBody As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal TessTolFactor As System.Double, _
 ByVal StartMatchingType As System.Short, _
 ByVal EndMatchingType As System.Short _
) As Body2

params.name: PModDoc
params.desc: Model document in which to create the lofted body

params.name: IsBlendClosed
params.desc: True for a closed, false for an open loft; if true and you selected less that three profiles; any selected guide curves must be closed curves

params.name: KeepTangency
params.desc:
If the section curves are tangent, then you have the option to specify whether the resulting faces are also tangent; specify true to maintain the tangency as seen in the section curves, false to not 
 NOTE: When generating tangent surfaces, SOLIDWORKS maintains planar and cylindrical surface shapes if the section curves exhibit these characteristics.

params.name: ForceNonRational
params.desc: True to force the resulting surface to be non-rational, false to not

params.name: IsSolidBody
params.desc: True to return a solid body, false to return a surface body

params.name: TessTolFactor
params.desc: Factor to control the number of intermediate sections used for loft with centerline; default value is 1.0; the greater the variable, the more intermediate sections created

params.name: StartMatchingType
params.desc: Tangency type at the start profile (see Remarks )

params.name: EndMatchingType
params.desc: Tangency type as the end profile (see Remarks )

 ByVal PModDoc As ModelDoc2, _

 ByVal ThinType As System.Integer, _
 ByVal Thickness1 As System.Double, _
 ByVal Thickness2 As System.Double, _
 ByVal FeatureScope As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsBlendClosed As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal KeepTangency As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal ForceNonRational As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsSolidBody As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal TessTolFactor As System.Double, _
 ByVal StartTangentLength As

params.name: PModDoc
params.desc: Model document in which to create the loft body

params.name: Profile
params.desc: Array of sketches representing the profiles of the loft body

params.name: GuideCurve
params.desc: Array of sketches representing the guide curves of the loft body

params.name: Centerline
params.desc: Sketch representing a centerline of the loft body

params.name: IsThinBody
params.desc: True if the loft body is to be a thin body, false if not

params.name: ThinType
params.desc:
0 = One direction 
 
 1 = One direction reverse 
 
 2 = Midplane 
 
 3 = Two direction

params.name: Thickness1
params.desc: Value for thickness for first direction if a thin body

params.name: Thickness2
params.desc: Value for thickness for second direction if a thin body

params.name: FeatureScope
params.desc: True if the loft body only affects selected bodies, false if the loft body affects all bodies

params.name: IsBlendClosed
params.desc: True for a closed loft, false for an open loft; if true and you selected less that three profiles, then any selected guide curves must be closed curves

params.name: KeepTangency
params.desc:
If the section curves are tangent, then you have the option to specify whether the resulting faces are also tangent; specify true to maintain the tangency as seen in the section curves, false to not 
 NOTE: When generating tangent surfaces, SOLIDWORKS maintains planar and cylindrical surface shapes if the section curves exhibit these characteristics.

params.name: ForceNonRational
params.desc: True to force the resulting surface to be non-rational, false to not

params.name: IsSolidBody
params.desc: True to return a solid loft body, false to return a surface loft body

params.name: TessTolFactor
params.desc: Factor to control the number of intermediate sections used for loft with centerline; default value is 1.0; the greater the variable, the more intermediate sections created

params.name: StartTangentLength
params.desc: Start tangent length

params.name: EndTangentLength
params.desc: End tangent length

params.name: StartTangentDir
params.desc: True is one direction, false is the opposite direction

params.name: EndTangentDir
params.desc: True is one direction, false is the opposite direction

params.name: StartMatchingType
params.desc:
Tangency type at the start profile: 
 
 
 0 = none 
 
 1 = tangent to the normal of the profile 
 
 2 = tangent to the selected vector 
 
 3 = tangent to all adjacent faces sharing an edge with the start profile

params.name: EndMatchingType
params.desc:
Tangency type as the end profile : 
 
 
 0 = none 
 
 1 = tangent to the normal of the profile 
 
 2 = tangent to the selected vector 
 
 3 = tangent to all adjacent faces sharing an edge with the start profile

params.name: Merge
params.desc: True merges the results in a multibody part, false does not

params.name: IsThinBody

params.desc: Thickness value for the first direction

params.name: Thickness2
params.desc: Thickness value for the second direction

params.name: ThinType

params.name: PathAlign

IPartDoc.ExportToDWG.title: ExportToDWG Method (IPartDoc)
IPartDoc.ExportToDWG.decl:
Function ExportToDWG( _
 ByVal FilePath As System.String, _
 ByVal ModelName As System.String, _
 ByVal Action As System.Integer, _
 ByVal ExportToSingleFile As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal Alignment As System.Object, _
 ByVal IsXDirFlipped As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsYDirFlipped As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal SheetMetalOptions As System.Integer, _
 ByVal Views As System.Object _
) As System.Boolean

params.name: FilePath
params.desc: Full path to the directory of the exported DXF/DWG file

params.name: ModelName
params.desc: File and path name of the active part document

params.name: Action
params.desc:
1 - export sheet metal (valid only if active document contains sheet metal) 
 2 - export selected faces or loops 
 3 - export annotation views

params.name: ExportToSingleFile
params.desc: True to save as one file; false to save in separate files

params.name: Alignment
params.desc:
Array of twelve double values that contain information related to output alignment: 
 
 Array[0], Array[1], Array[2] - XYZ coordinates of new origin 
 Array[3], Array[4], Array[5] - coordinates of new x direction vector 
 Array[6], Array[7], Array[8] - coordinates of new y direction vector 
 Array[9], Array[10], Array[11] - coordinates of the vector that is normal to the selected faces or loops 
 The last three elements of the array are valid only if Action = 2

params.name: IsXDirFlipped
params.desc: True to flip the x direction; false otherwise

params.name: IsYDirFlipped
params.desc: True to flip the y direction; false otherwise

params.name: SheetMetalOptions
params.desc:
Bitmask that contains sheet metal export options; valid only if Action = 1: 
 The bitmask is {7 6 5 4 3 2 1}, where each bit is either 0 or 1 as follows: 
 
 Bit #1: 1 to export geometry; 0 to not 
 Bit #2: 1 to include hidden edges; 0 to not 
 Bit #3: 1 to export bend lines; 0 to not 
 Bit #4: 1 to include sketches; 0 to not 
 Bit #5: 1 to merge coplanar faces; 0 to not 
 Bit #6: 1 to export library features; 0 to not 
 Bit #7: 1 to export forming tools; 0 to not 
 Example 
 If you want to export flat pattern geometry, bend lines, and sketches, then Bits 1, 3, and 4 are 1, the bitmask is 0001101, and you need to set SheetMetalOptions = 2^0 + 2^2 + 2^3 = 1 + 4 + 8 = 13.

params.name: Views
params.desc: Array of annotation view names to export; valid only if Action = 3

IPartDoc.IExportToDWG.title: IExportToDWG Method (IPartDoc)
IPartDoc.IExportToDWG.decl:
Function IExportToDWG( _
 ByVal FilePath As System.String, _
 ByVal ModelName As System.String, _
 ByVal Action As System.Integer, _
 ByVal ExportToSingleFile As System.Boolean, _
 ByRef Alignment As System.Double, _
 ByVal IsXDirFlipped As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal IsYDirFlipped As System.Boolean, _
 ByVal SheetMetalOptions As System.Integer, _
 ByVal ViewsCount As System.Integer, _
 ByRef Views As System.String _
) As System.Boolean

params.name: FilePath
params.desc: Full path to the exported DXF/DWG file

params.name: ModelName
params.desc: Full path to the active part document

params.name: Action
params.desc:
1 - export sheet metal (valid only if active document contains sheet metal) 
 2 - export selected faces or loops 
 3 - export annotation views

params.name: ExportToSingleFile
params.desc: True to save as one file; false to save in separate files

params.name: Alignment
params.desc:
Array of twelve double values that contain information related to output alignment: 
 
 Array[0], Array[1], Array[2] - XYZ coordinates of new origin 
 Array[3], Array[4], Array[5] - coordinates of new x direction vector 
 Array[6], Array[7], Array[8] - coordinates of new y direction vector 
 Array[9], Array[10], Array[11] - coordinates of the vector that is normal to the selected faces or loops 
 The last three elements of the array are valid only if Action = 2

params.name: IsXDirFlipped
params.desc: True to flip the x direction; false otherwise

params.name: IsYDirFlipped
params.desc: True to flip the y direction; false otherwise

params.name: SheetMetalOptions
params.desc:
Bitmask that contains sheet metal export options; valid only if Action = 1: 
 The bitmask is {7 6 5 4 3 2 1}, where each bit is either 0 or 1 as follows: 
 
 Bit #1: 1 to export geometry; 0 to not 
 Bit #2: 1 to include hidden edges; 0 to not 
 Bit #3: 1 to export bend lines; 0 to not 
 Bit #4: 1 to include sketches; 0 to not 
 Bit #5: 1 to merge coplanar faces; 0 to not 
 Bit #6: 1 to export library features; 0 to not 
 Bit #7: 1 to export forming tools; 0 to not 
 Example 
 If you want to export flat pattern geometry, bend lines, and sketches, then Bits 1, 3, and 4 are 1, the bitmask is 0001101, and you need to set SheetMetalOptions = 2^0 + 2^2 + 2^3 = 1 + 4 + 8 = 13.

params.name: ViewsCount
params.desc: Count of annotation views to export; valid only if Action = 3

params.name: Views
params.desc: Array of annotation view names to export; valid only if Action = 3

params.name: Identifier
params.desc: ID of the add-in; value of the Cookie argument passed by ISwAddin::ConnectToSW

params.name: CallbackFunction
params.desc:
Function called when user clicks the shortcut menu item; specify an empty string if MenuItemTypeOption is: 
 
 swMenuItemType_e .swMenuItemType_Break 
 swMenuItemType_e .swMenuItemType_Separator 
 (see Remarks )

params.name: EnableFunction
params.desc:
Optional function that controls the state of the shortcut menu item 
 If specified, SOLIDWORKS: 
 
 
 calls this function before displaying the menu 
 
 displays the menu item according to the return value of this function 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If EnableFunction returns... 
 Then SOLIDWORKS... 
 
 
 
 0 
 
 Deselects and disables the menu item 
 
 
 1 
 
 Deselects and enables the menu item; this is the default menu state if EnableFunction is not specified 
 
 
 2 
 
 Selects and disables the menu item 
 
 
 3 
 
 Selects and enables the menu item Specify an empty string if MenuItemTypeOption is: 
 
 swMenuItemType_e .swMenuItemType_Break 
 swMenuItemType_e .swMenuItemType_Separator 
 (see Remarks )

params.name: CustomName
params.desc: Empty string

params.name: HintString
params.desc: Text to display in the SOLIDWORKS status bar when users move the mouse over this shortcut menu item

params.desc:

 Specify an empty string if MenuItemTypeOption is: 
 
 swMenuItemType_e .swMenuItemType_Break

params.name: DocumentType
params.desc: Document type to add the menu item as defined by swDocumentTypes_e

params.name: Cookie
params.desc: Cookie specified as defined in ISwAddin::ConnectToSW

params.name: MenuItem
params.desc:
Menu string ("menuItem@menuString"); SOLIDWORKS creates menu items only if they do not already exist 
 NOTE: 
 
 If you do not specify menuString, then the menu item appears on the Tools menu below the Xpress Products menu item. 
 Use the & symbol to include an accelerator key, e.g., "MyItem@&File" adds MyItem to the File menu with an accelerator key. To display the accelerator key, press the Alt key in SOLIDWORKS. The accelerator key is underlined.

params.name: Position
params.desc:
Position at which to add the new menu item 
 The first item is at position 0; if Position is -1, then the new menu item is added to the bottom of the list; this argument specifies the position of the menu item in relation to its immediate parent menu

params.name: MenuCallback
params.desc: Function to call when this menu item is selected

params.name: MenuEnableMethod
params.desc:
Optional function that controls the state of the menu item 
 If specified: 
 
 
 SOLIDWORKS calls this function before displaying the menu. 
 
 Display of the menu item is controlled by the return value of MenuEnableMethod. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 If your method returns... 
 
 Then SOLIDWORKS... 
 
 
 
 0 
 
 Deselects and disables the menu item 
 
 
 1 
 
 Deselects and enables the menu item; this is the default menu state if no update function is specified 
 
 
 2 
 
 Selects and disables the menu item 
 
 
 3 
 
 Selects and enables the menu item

params.name: HintString
params.desc: Text to show in the SOLIDWORKS status bar when the user moves their mouse over this menu item; if you specify HintString, then it must be preceded by a comma

params.name: BitmapFilePath
params.desc: Path and filename of bitmap

ISurface.AddTrimmingLoop2.title: AddTrimmingLoop2 Method (ISurface)
ISurface.AddTrimmingLoop2.decl:
Function AddTrimmingLoop2( _
 ByVal NCrvs As System.Integer, _
 ByVal VOrder As System.Object, _
 ByVal VDim As System.Object, _
 ByVal VPeriodic As System.Object, _
 ByVal VNumKnots As System.Object, _
 ByVal VNumCtrlPoints As System.Object, _
 ByVal VKnots As System.Object, _
 ByVal VCtrlPointDbls As System.Object, _
 ByVal UvRange As System.Object _
) As System.Boolean

params.name: NCrvs
params.desc: Number of surface parametric (UV) curves constituting the loop and the size of each of the VOrder, VDim, VPeriodic, VNumKnots, VNumControlPnts arrays

params.name: VOrder
params.desc: Array containing NCrvs longs (VBA), Integers (VB.NET), or ints (C#, C++) representing orders of the curves (see Remarks )

params.name: VDim
params.desc: Array containing NCrvs longs (VBA), Integers (VB.NET), or ints (C#, C++) representing dimensions (2, 3, or 4) of the control points of the curves (see Remarks )

params.name: VPeriodic
params.desc: Array containing NCrvs longs (VBA), Integers (VB.NET), or ints (C#, C++) representing whether the curve is periodic (1) or non-periodic (0) (see Remarks )

params.name: VNumKnots
params.desc: Array containing NCrvs longs (VBA), Integers (VB.NET), or ints (C#, C++) representing number of knots on the curves (see Remarks )

params.name: VNumCtrlPoints
params.desc: Array containing NCrvs longs (VBA), Integers (VB.NET), or ints (C#, C++) representing number of control points on the curves (see Remarks )

params.name: VKnots
params.desc: Knot vector array of <TotalNumKnots> doubles, where TotalNumKnots = (TotalNumKnots + VNumKnots[i]) for i = 1 to NCrvs (see Remarks )

params.name: VCtrlPointDbls
params.desc: Control point coordinate array of <TotalNumCPCoords> doubles, where TotalNumCPCoords = (TotalNumCPCoords + (VDim[i] * VNumCtrlPoints[i])) for i = 1 to NCrvs (see Remarks )

params.name: UvRange
params.desc: Array of four doubles representing U Low, U High, V Low, and V High (see Remarks )
